NORMALIZED_2026-08-02: point-type grid refs were written with a dash (C-1). Schema section 4 reserves the dash for a RANGE only; a point is row+column with no dash (C1), which is what houses 01-05 use throughout. Only values under grid_ref/grid_ref_start/grid_ref_end/grid_refs were touched, so sheet_code (S-04) could not be hit.

pattern re-labelled 'etc_plan' -> 'beam_plan' on 2026-08-28, closing the schema section-1 plan-family split (the split created beam_plan/footing_plan/roof_frame_plan but every legacy file had been bulk-renamed to etc_plan, which section 1 defines as the residual 'not a beam plan, not a footing plan, not a roof-framing plan'). Decided from what the sheet DRAWS -- discipline plus the element_type mix, with the view's own title as tie-breaker -- never from the filename alone. Reason: 24 beam-family elements. Nothing else in this file changed.
